description: This file contains utility functions for making API GET requests, including URL construction, auth header management, and organization ID handling, specifically tailored for a React-based frontend project.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl(url)
methods.description: Checks if a given URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: getBaseApiUrl()
methods.description: Determines the base URL for API requests, prioritizing configured values, environment variables, and defaulting to '/api'.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Joins a base URL with a path, handling absolute URLs and ensuring correct joining under '/api'.

methods.name: ensureOrgIdInUrl(url, explicitOrgId)
methods.description: Appends the organization_id parameter to the URL if it's not already present.

methods.name: apiGet(pathOrUrl, options = {})
methods.description: Main exported function that performs a GET request to a specified path or URL, handling URL construction, authorization headers, organization ID injection, and response parsing.
